name: seo-backlink-audit
summary: Audit bounded external-link profiles with source-labeled provider, crawl, first-party, and manual evidence.
writes: Home.md review link when review is required
approval_gates: provider_availability: run bounded read-only checks against approved integration surfaces; do not reveal secrets or probe arbitrary services
external_read: ask before live provider, Common Crawl, or external page reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require applicable approval
vault_write: save only to a resolved project, client, or prospect context when authorized
external_mutation: link buying, outreach, disavowal, redirects, CMS, code, publishing, production, and provider configuration are out of scope
done_when: domain, target pages, market, date range, provider scope, and audit date are explicit
provider status and freshness are recorded for every declared source
counts and metrics are source-labeled and not presented as universal truth
link quality findings use context and more than one signal where appropriate
missing, sampled, stale, or partial data is visible before conclusions
no toxic-link, ranking, traffic, authority, revenue, or conversion guarantee is made
handoffs to opportunity, competitor-comparison, and reclaim workflows are explicit
durable artifact uses project/client/prospect routing and review frontmatter
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred with an actionable reason
verification: verify unavailable providers produced no fabricated counts or links
verify paid or credentialed calls had approval
verify no link buying, outreach, disavowal, redirect, CMS, code, publishing, or production mutation occurred
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter and Home review registration when applicable
